about: Escitalopram supplies span more than 12 months, and the latest assessment documents full remission of the anxiety disorder treated with escitalopram.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about anxiety or remission, while Zoloft (sertraline) is supplied every month for 14 months.
The anxiety disorder is in full remission, but review falls exactly twelve months after sertraline restarted despite an earlier supply and tablets remaining after review.
